text:
sasha: Heads-up — after rolling Mellanox microcode 2.34 + kernel 6.1.12 backports to eu-west2 prod (canary), we're seeing 32-GPU AllReduce tail latency spikes ~2-3x. NCCL retransmits and chunk stalls. Suspect NIC TX pacing + multipath steering regression.

infra-bot: Created INF-4221 and attached pnfs logs.

tereza: Can you paste the nic counters / rdma stats from one of affected nodes?

sasha: Pasting quick outputs from node gpu-euw2-03:
```
ethtool -S ens5 | egrep "tx_|rx_|peer_"
mlx5_core stats shows tx_packets_reset=125, tx_wqe_drop=18
ibv_devinfo shows port counters: tx_err=42 rx_err=4
ibdev2netdev mapping shows rdma->eth mismatched stats on mlx5_0
```

mike: Interesting — kernel 6.1 backport changed skb tx pacing defaults on Mellanox drivers a while back. Could be pacing algo + combined LAG/multipath causing bursts that overflow firmware pacing windows. Have we toggled ethtool features?

jake: Quick mitigation ideas (low blast):
- disable TSO/GSO on the NIC: `ethtool -K ens5 tso off gso off`
- set txqueuelen to 5000: `ip link set dev ens5 txqueuelen 5000`
- temporarily disable netdev RSS multipath: `echo 0 > /sys/class/net/ens5/queues/rx-*/rps_cpus` (depends on kernel)

tereza: Also try disabling GRO: `ethtool -K ens5 gro off` and check `cat /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run`? (just kidding on ksm) :eyes:

sasha: Applied `ethtool -K ens5 tso off gso off gro off` and txqueuelen tweak on one canary node. Job resumed but still ~1.5x tail compared to pre-upgrade. So partial improvement.

oncall_ryan: I'm going to roll the microcode back to 2.30 on a 10-node subset (same AZ) and run a control AllReduce. Will report in ~15m.

mike: Also check mlx5_core params: `log_num_mtt` and `mlx5_core.slow_path_tx_timeout_ms`? There was a FW change that made small wqes be paced differently. If rollback fixes it, vendor bug.

oncall_ryan: rollback done on 10 nodes (gpu-euw2-03..12). Running 32-GPU AllReduce now. Observed tail back to baseline within 3 minutes. No retransmits on those nodes.

sasha: Confirmed — rolled nodes match baseline performance. Non-rolled still showing spikes. Marking as mitigated for now.

tereza: Filing an upstream vendor bug with the packet captures + hw counters (INF-4221). Assigning to vendor with priority P1 for visibility.

mike: Action items:
- Do not promote microcode 2.34 fleetwide until vendor provides fix.
- Add a canary gate for microcode + kernel combos on perf-critical clusters.
- Add `ethtool -K ...` mitigations as an ops playbook for temporary relief.

jake: For Dedicated customers, we should proactively notify that microcode upgrades are paused in eu-west2 and add a note to maintenance dashboard.

sasha: Will update INF-4221 with the mitigations and candidate rollback changelist. Thanks all.

infra-bot: INF-4221 status -> Mitigated (rollback). Logs attached to ticket.

tereza: Follow-up: collect full tcpdump + mlx5 counters and request FW trace from vendor. We'll also run synthetic perf matrix across kernel 5.15/6.1/6.4 combos in staging.

mike: TL;DR — microcode 2.34 + 6.1 backports interact badly with Mellanox pacing/multipath; rollback fixes.

sasha: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if vendor backport causes different behavior. :white_check_mark:
